notes.title: 1.0.6 - Last Bug Patch for the Week
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your patience this past week!

If the slow-down of bug reports is anything to go by, our big fix yesterday solved a lot of the problems people are having.
As always, if you're facing any difficulties please let me know in the Steam Community forums, on our Discord or though the in-game feedback system.

1.0.6 Fixes:
-set sigils on fire too so people know the Act 3 puzzle is locked out if you complete Act 3 Route D
-Turn off Jelvis in the bathroom when he shouldnt be there >:I
-Lift the save spawner in Cal's room up!!!
-Make sure Beta's has no combat consent
-Make sure Carrie doesn't phase through the floor
-Make sure Carrie starts on the main floor if you come out of the cavern
-Make sure Charon isn't on in the Ana State 8 convo on roof before she needs to be


May you all solve your unfinished business!

-Rebecca

notes.title: Release Date Announcement & Games with Wings Showcase!!! 🪽
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone 👋

This has been really tough to keep quiet about, but the day has finally come to share the news…

 Freeride is launching May 1st!!! 🚂⭐⭐⭐

[previewyoutube=V3kgGE0I3hM;full][/previewyoutube]

We JUST announced the release date as part of the fabulous Games with Wings Showcase, celebrating all the lovely Women in Games 💪In case you missed it, don’t fear!! You can watch it all back here and be sure to check out all the other incredible titles.


I can’t wait to finally hand the full game to you and see what you think of this weird and wonderful world we’ve been working on for over 10 YEARS! So in the meantime, be sure to add Freeride to your Wishlist join our discord and follow us on Twitter/X, Threads & Tiktok! Oh and also tell all your friends! 🎉

May you Solve your Unfinished Business,

-The Flightyfelon Games Team

notes.title: 🌻Wholesome Games Feature🌻, Release Window, Brand New Trailer, and NEXT FEST!!!
notes.notes:
Rebecca from Flightyfelon Games here, with some exciting news I’ve been dying to share with you all:

We were part of this summer’s Wholesome Games Direct!

This means we’ve got a shiny new trailer (you can watch it below!) which shows some never-before-seen footage of Acts 2, 3 and Intermission! 

[previewyoutube=FyPraUZnUsI;full][/previewyoutube]

You may have also noticed that we surprise released the demo on Nintendo Switch during the Direct, which has been a goal for us for a long time. 
*It’s still only out on the European store for red-tape reasons, but all accounts will have access soon!

We’re also taking part in the Women-Led Games Steam event, so be sure to check out both Freeride and all the other amazing games created by women-led and women-majority teams. :D

Following all of this, Freeride will be hopping into Steam Next Fest in a couple of days, so if you’ve not played the demo yet (or you fancy another loop to find out if you’re a Friend or a Clown) then now is the perfect time!
🚂✨✨✨

New Co-Publisher!
Future Friends Games is now working with us to get Freeride in your hands. You may know them as the publisher of games like Europa, SUMMERHOUSE, Omno, Gourdlets, or Exo One. Please give them a warm welcome. <3 

Release Window
And last but certainly not least: Freeride will be released in Q1 of 2025! 
There’s still lots of work to do until then, but with the support of players like you we are filled with motivation. With the incredible community on Discord, and all the amazing comments you’ve sent our way on social media – we feel so lucky to be sharing this game with all of you!

Your Feedback
We’ve got our ears peeled like Solo’s – tell us what you’d love to know about Freeride after this trailer here/on our Discord/on our socials (TikTok, Twitter/X, Instagram/Threads). :) We’re happy to sate your curiosities (unless they involve Ajo’s ice cream flavors). 

That’s it for now, we can’t wait to show more as we draw closer to the release window! Take care and don’t forget that Freeride is watching you as you play…, we’ve got our eyes on you, you sillies. 🤡

May you solve your Unfinished Business, 

-The Flightyfelon Games Team
